name: dsh-plugin-jev
description: Agent-facing TypeSafe Jev (System One) for DSH — a jev_ask tool the model calls, a host-side decision service for plugins, a command guard that blocks dangerous or forbidden shell commands, a per-chat usage chip, and a Settings tab for the key, model choice, and overall stats

scripts.test: npm run check:build && node test/host.test.mjs && node test/tool.test.mjs && node test/service.test.mjs && node test/guard.test.mjs && node test/key.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs && node test/docs.test.mjs
